text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock A after large gains, then held through later portfolio declines; I should use a consistent valuation and rebalancing plan rather than sell solely to enjoy a realized gain.","My account fell from its period 7 peak despite making no trades, reminding me that inaction is also a decision: I should periodically check whether the portfolio’s risk and diversification still fit my goals.","A few periods of losses should not prompt panic trading, but my reluctance to sell at a loss must not prevent me from reassessing a position when its outlook or role in the portfolio has changed."]}
